input: Get the piano tuned before the holidays

gold.taskTitle: Get the Piano Tuned Before the Holidays
gold.taskDescription: Arrange for a professional piano tuner to service the piano in time for the upcoming holiday period.

questions.title: Which holiday is your hard deadline for this?
questions.description: Identify the specific holiday date acting as the deadline so a realistic schedule can be built.

questions.title: Do you already have a piano tuner in mind?
questions.description: Determine whether the user has a preferred or previously used tuner, or needs to find one from scratch.

questions.title: When was the piano last professionally tuned?
questions.description: Understand the current condition of the piano to gauge urgency and the level of service needed.

questions.title: What type and size of piano needs tuning?
questions.description: Identify whether it is an upright, grand, or digital piano, as this affects tuner selection and cost.

questions.title: What city or area is the piano located in?
questions.description: Pinpoint the location so local tuner options and travel considerations can be factored in.

questions.title: What is your budget for the tuning service?
questions.description: Establish a spending limit to narrow down suitable tuners and avoid unexpected costs.

questions.title: Are there specific days or times you are available?
questions.description: Capture scheduling constraints so appointment booking can be planned around the user's availability.
